hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); printf '%s\n' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|(]+)[[:space:]]*((yarn|pnpm)[[:space:]]+build|npm[[:space:]]+run[[:space:]]+build|(npx[[:space:]]+)?next[[:space:]]+(build|start))([[:space:]]|$)' || exit 0; procs=$(pgrep -fl "next[ ]dev" 2>/dev/null; pgrep -fl "next[-]server" 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$procs" ] && exit 0; jq -nc --arg p "$procs" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:("Blocked: a Next server is already running (" + $p + "). A production build rewrites the shared .next directory, so the live server starts 500ing with \"Cannot find module ./chunks/vendor-chunks/*\" until it is restarted. Stop that server first, or verify without touching .next: npx tsc --noEmit, yarn lint, yarn test.")}}'
hooks.statusMessage: Checking for a running dev server
